source.title: Top Gainer in the Market is +2,493% TODAY!

research_notes: This is a boundary case for upstream stock selection, execution/no-fill behavior and discretionary skip logic, not a primary Micro v0.1 setup score.
The fact that price later went higher must not retroactively convert the skipped/no-fill behavior into a strategy error.
This retrospective label must never be supplied to a policy replaying September 9, 2025.
